mentions.name: BobrChat
mentions.description: A multi-model chat application that provides insight into the token cost of each message, helping users save money on AI credits compared to typical subscription plans.
mentions.problem: AI chat subscriptions are costly and opaque about per-message token costs; the author used to pay $8/month on other services and now spends around $4.
mentions.source_excerpt: built a multi-model chat application (https://bobrchat.com/) to provide better insights into what each message costs in tokens

evidence.value: built a multi-model chat application (https://bobrchat.com/) to provide better insights into what each message costs in tokens
